key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate; unlobed to shallowly 3-lobed or with small toothlike lobes.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: About 8–9 mm at maturity with a distinctive subterminal fingerlike/awnlike projection.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Small scarlet to light-scarlet, salverform/trumpet-like; limb about 12–17 mm across.

key_traits.label: Key
key_traits.text: Small scarlet flowers and awnlike sepal tips separate it quickly from the purple/blue core species.
